name: Xiaojiang Zhang
about: I am with the School of Mathematics and Statistics at Central South University, which I joined in July 2024. I received my Ph.D. in Computational Mathematics from Shanghai Jiao Tong University in 2022, advised by Professor Min Tang, and my B.Sc. in Mathematics and Applied Mathematics from Central South University in 2016. From 2022 to 2024, I was a postdoctoral researcher at the Institute of Natural Sciences, Shanghai Jiao Tong University.
research: Numerical methods for partial differential equations and multiscale problems
Asymptotic-preserving schemes for radiative transfer and radiation magnetohydrodynamics
Particle methods for kinetic equations in strongly magnetized regimes
Deterministic numerical methods for proton transport and dose calculation
